thread:
anna_sales: Prospect (regional payments) asked for a short POC: BYOK + daily ephemeral KEKs + an auditable offline key ceremony. Need quick feasibility and a topline price to share.

rex_se: Feasible. POC topology: Redwood staging talks to their HSM gateway via mTLS. We support wrapping DEKs with their CMK (PKCS#11). Daily ephemeral KEKs are OK if ephemeral = per-day DEK.

julia_crypto: Attestation: we can emit signed op receipts with PKCS#11 op IDs and forward to their SIEM. For an offline ceremony, propose a scripted dry-run: generate key shares, exchange attestation blobs, and validate signatures.

sam_ops: Ops checklist for POC: provide HSM endpoint IPs, mTLS cert, and a maintenance window for the ceremony. We'll stand up a 48h soak cluster and monitor wrap latency + errors.

anna_sales: Pricing ask: do we bill per crypto-op or a flat connector fee for the POC? They want budgeting clarity.

rex_se: Recommend: POC = fixed one-time setup + small hourly engineering. Production options: hosted per-token + HSM-proxy add-on billed per-1k crypto ops, or dedicated connector monthly + usage tiers for very high qps.

julia_crypto: Note perf: proxying to external HSM adds ~10-30ms per operation depending on network. If they need <50ms p95 end-to-end and many inline wraps, we should advise caching wrapped prefixes or Dedicated.

carmen_legal: I'll prepare a short Key Custody appendix: state Redwood never has CMK plaintext, outline ceremony witness steps, and list escrow retrieval fees.

anna_sales: Good. Can someone post a minimal runbook snippet I can send?

rex_se: Runbook snippet:
```
1) Collect HSM IPs & mTLS certs (T-3d)
2) Connectivity test: pkcs11 list-keys
3) Dry-run ceremony (no real keys)
4) 48h soak + collect attestation logs
```

anna_sales: Perfect  I'll update the prospect and schedule the dry-run. Thanks all :rocket:
